gaps.question: Exact source-compatible month/day at campaign start
gaps.resolution_rule: Original campaign start fixed to 2670-08-31 06:00 Asterline Civic Time; T0 fixed to 2670-09-14 06:00. Source-exact date remains a separate paused evidence question.

gaps.question: Exact Earth coordinates/nation/state/city of pre-academy residence
gaps.resolution_rule: Asterline Metropolitan Cooperative District placed at original-canon Earth coordinates with Atlantic Civic Union jurisdiction; no 2026 border assumption.

gaps.question: Start-region climate/season/weather baseline
gaps.resolution_rule: Humid temperate maritime climate, late-summer season, exact start weather and hazard ranges established.

gaps.question: Residential district population, households and demographics
gaps.resolution_rule: Immediate 72-resident/28-household census retained; macro population can aggregate until instantiated.

gaps.question: Civilian filler NPC roster/schedules for immediate district
gaps.resolution_rule: Immediate schedules plus macro offscreen tick rules provide operational NPC behavior; private biographies are generated when relevant.

gaps.question: Exact civil government structure at start location
gaps.resolution_rule: Terran Compact, Atlantic Civic Union and 21-seat Asterline metro governance established as original campaign canon.

gaps.question: Exact source statute names, sentences, fines and service-compulsion law
gaps.resolution_rule: Original Asterline civil law/offense tiers/ability rules created. This closes operational law without claiming source statute accuracy.

gaps.question: Credit issuer/payment rails and local income/rent/utility levels
gaps.resolution_rule: Terran Clearing Cooperative issuer, payment rails, wage/rent/utility/welfare bands and labor rules established.

gaps.question: Start district power, water, waste and communications topology
gaps.resolution_rule: Regional upstream power/water/waste/comms providers and generation architecture established in addition to local topology.

gaps.question: Local civilian transit network and transport-to-academy exact route distance
gaps.resolution_rule: Exact original-canon 46.8-km intake route, Ravelin Academy destination, vehicle and 71-minute schedule established.

gaps.question: Public policing/security coverage, response station and surveillance density
gaps.resolution_rule: Civil public-safety hierarchy, evidence/privacy rules and emergency incident levels established.

gaps.question: Nearest civilian clinic/service capability
gaps.resolution_rule: Neighborhood through regional trauma network and referral distances/capabilities established.

gaps.question: Finite local shop stock/replenishment/budgets
gaps.resolution_rule: Neighborhood/metro/regional/offworld supply tiers, finite-stock and crafting/feedstock constraints established.

gaps.question: Local media/VR venues
gaps.resolution_rule: Media ownership, public/commercial/creator networks, VR, authentication and rumor model established.

gaps.question: Pre-academy civilian school history for Jack
gaps.resolution_rule: World education system is READY, but Jack's exact prior school/grades/friends remain intentionally unfilled until user/gameplay establishes them.

gaps.question: Source reconstruction after chapter 310
gaps.resolution_rule: Raw novel/story-ending reconstruction remains paused by user directive and is not required for original-campaign world operation.

gaps.question: Source-neighbor interior, schedule and private future knowledge
gaps.resolution_rule: Source-neighbor private interior/future remains blocked; do not invent private source knowledge.

gaps.question: Local language/culture/religion/holidays
gaps.resolution_rule: Asterline languages, plural belief model, holidays, social norms and privacy customs established as original campaign canon.

gaps.question: Global political borders and current government map in 2670
gaps.resolution_rule: Ten macro civil polities plus Terran Civic Compact framework established without importing 2026 national borders.

gaps.question: Earth post-war ecology and ordinary animal distribution near start
gaps.resolution_rule: Managed postwar biosphere and Asterline ordinary species/green-infrastructure model established.

rule: Operational campaign gaps may close with explicit ORIGINAL_CAMPAIGN_CANON. Source-exact reconstruction and player-private biography stay separately labeled and never block normal play.
